mapper.select: SELECT mp.id, sf.original_file_name FROM manual_knowledge_projection_v1 mp JOIN knowledge_unit_source kus ON kus.knowledge_unit_version_id = mp.knowledge_unit_version_id AND kus.relation_type = 'PRIMARY' JOIN source_record sr ON sr.id = kus.source_record_id JOIN source_file sf ON sf.id = sr.source_file_id WHERE mp.id = #{manualKnowledgeId} AND sf.source_kind IN ('SERVICE_MANUAL', 'PARTS_MANUAL') AND sf.status = 'VALIDATED' LIMIT 1
